answer: I would anchor trust in Signed folk dance troupe membership with folk dance society attestation. With a membership the society kept across years of dances, a single delta check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a membership the society kept across years of dances takes calendar time as well as money — and the signal is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the summit of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
